summary: Maps a single integer a1 into one of five ranks via ascending thresholds: 0 when a1 <= 1487, 1 when a1 <= 2975, 2 in the default band, and 3 or 4 when a1 > 7200 depending on whether a1 > 28800. A pure classification helper; exact quantity ranked is unknown.

local_names.a1: input value classified into a rank

operations.description: If a1 <= 1487, take the first branch and return 0.
If a1 <= 2975, take the second branch and return 1.
If a1 > 7200, evaluate the high-threshold branch; otherwise fall through to the default band.
Compare a1 against 28800 and add the boolean result to 3, yielding 3 when a1 <= 28800 and 4 when a1 > 28800.
Return (a1 > 28800) + 3 for a1 > 7200; return 2 for the default band (1487 < a1 <= 7200).

unresolved: What a1 measures (distance, score, time, count) and what the five output ranks mean are unknown from the packet.
